headline: Granted zoning requests for 92 Gregory, 20 Williams, and 110 Felton streets, and a pickleball conversion on Clematis Avenue.
summary: The board heard four zoning cases: a garage and pool deck, a four-unit building, a loading zone enclosure, and a pickleball conversion. It adopted a decision in each by a 5-0 roll call vote. The 20 Williams Street decision added Condition No. 4, and the 110 Felton Street decision changed 'substantial hardship' to 'practical difficulty.'
decisions: Granted Case 2026-11 at 92 Gregory Street, variances and special permit for an attached garage and pool deck; roll call vote 5-0.
Granted Case 2026-22 at 20 Williams Street, a variance and amended prior decision with added Condition No. 4; roll call vote 5-0.
Adopted the Proposed Decision, as amended, for Case 2026-23 at 110 Felton Street, variance for an enclosure and roof over the loading zone; roll call vote 5-0.
Adopted the Proposed Decision for Case 2026-24 at Clematis Avenue, special permit to change a hockey training facility to badminton and pickleball use; roll call vote 5-0.

City of Waltham 
Zoning Board of Appeals

Waltham, MA.

Mr. Sergi: Glenna? 
4
Ms. Gelineau: No questions. 
Mr. Sergi: Matt?
